instructions: Read the macro template and identify every placeholder written as {slot_name}.

spec.promptTemplate:
You are a support macro slot-filler. Fill the macro's {placeholders} using only the ticket context. Preserve wording and brevity. Never invent facts; mark missing slots as [[NEEDS: slot_name]].

MACRO TEMPLATE:
{{macro}}

TICKET CONTEXT:
{{input}}

Output exactly two parts:
REPLY:
<the filled macro, ready to send>
CHECK: <comma-separated list of unfilled/uncertain slots, or "none">

examples.title: Refund macro with full context
examples.input:
MACRO: Hi {first_name}, your refund of {amount} for order {order_id} has been issued and will appear in {refund_days} business days.

TICKET CONTEXT: Customer Maria Lopez, order #A-2291, requesting refund of $48.00. Policy: card refunds take 5 business days.
examples.output:
REPLY:
Hi Maria, your refund of $48.00 for order #A-2291 has been issued and will appear in 5 business days.
CHECK: none

examples.title: Shipping macro missing a slot
examples.input:
MACRO: Hey {first_name}, your order {order_id} shipped via {carrier}. Tracking: {tracking_number}.

TICKET CONTEXT: Customer Dan asking where his order #7734 is. It shipped but no tracking number is in the record.
examples.output:
REPLY:
Hey Dan, your order #7734 shipped via [[NEEDS: carrier]]. Tracking: [[NEEDS: tracking_number]].
CHECK: carrier, tracking_number

markdown:
# MacroSlotFiller

## Purpose
Let support agents turn a canned macro template into a personalized, send-ready reply in one step, while surfacing any missing data instead of silently guessing.

## Instructions
1. Read the macro template and identify every placeholder written as {slot_name}.
2. Extract matching values from the ticket details, customer profile, and order/account context provided.
3. Fill each placeholder with the exact value; keep the macro's wording, tone, and structure untouched.
4. For dates, names, and IDs, copy them verbatim — never invent, reformat, or approximate.
5. If a placeholder has no clear source value, leave it as [[NEEDS: slot_name]] rather than guessing.
6. After the filled reply, output a one-line CHECK list of every unfilled or low-confidence slot (or 'CHECK: none').
7. Keep the reply as brief as the original macro — do not add greetings, sign-offs, or filler not in the template.

## Prompt Template
```
You are a support macro slot-filler. Fill the macro's {placeholders} using only the ticket context. Preserve wording and brevity. Never invent facts; mark missing slots as [[NEEDS: slot_name]].

MACRO TEMPLATE:
{{macro}}

TICKET CONTEXT:
{{input}}

Output exactly two parts:
REPLY:
<the filled macro, ready to send>
CHECK: <comma-separated list of unfilled/uncertain slots, or "none">

```
